rows.note: Use 減少 as the all-purpose term for a gradual decrease in numbers.

example.english: The gradual decrease in reservoir storage over these years is a form of attrition.
example.traditional: 呢幾年，水塘嘅儲水量逐步減少。
example.jyutping: ne1 gei2 nin4 seoi2 tong4 ge3 cyu5 seoi2 loeng6 zuk6 bou6 gaam2 siu2

rows.note: Use 流失 when people, members, customers, or other participants gradually leave or are lost.

example.english: The attrition of longtime customers has made business harder.
example.traditional: 間公司近年流失咗好多熟客，生意難做咗。
example.jyutping: gaan1 gung1 si1 gan6 nin4 lau4 sat1 zo2 hou2 do1 suk6 haak3 saang1 ji3 naan4 zou6 zo2

rows.note: Use 磨損 for physical wearing away caused by friction.

example.english: Attrition from years of rubbing has worn the knees of these jeans thin.
example.traditional: 條牛仔褲嘅膝頭位着得耐，已經磨損晒。
example.jyutping: tiu4 ngau4 zai2 fu3 ge3 sat1 tau4 wai6 zoek6 dak1 noi6 ji5 ging1 mo4 syun2 saai3
